summary: Iteration 3 review: (1) Backend policy-report endpoint returns new fields version_no/is_current/changed correctly along with all legacy fields. (2) Frontend PolicyReportCard: collapsed by default, info icon toggles help without expanding, expand shows headline '15 Versionen', rows begin with 'Version ', row worlds toggle shows LIVE/PAPER/SAMMEL, days-select reloads, no horizontal overflow at 1920 and 390. (3) Backtester KI-Trader tab: 40 normal + 20 event rows, all event rows ordered AFTER normal rows. (4) Backtester stability: with route mocks (run + status running/cancelled) and admin login, clicking ai-seed-run keeps the table populated (40 normals + 20 events unchanged), ai-seed-progress appears and ai-seed-result-stale shows 'letzter Stand (neuer Lauf aktiv)'; after switching status to cancelled the table stays populated too. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: PolicyReportCard: subtitle format includes actual model slug (e.g. 'nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free') instead of the abstract label 'Modell' shown in the spec example – this is more informative but slightly deviates from the wording used in the requirement description. Not a bug, just verify wording is intentional.

Backtester ai-seed-result stale hint prefix begins with ' · letzter Stand (neuer Lauf aktiv)' – ensure no leading dot separator when the preceding text is absent (looks fine in current UI, but worth guarding).
seed_data_creation: None (used existing local Mongo seed: 48 trades → 14 versions + 1 legacy row, 40 normal setups + 20 event setups)
